extracted.intended_audience: researchers, prospective ERC applicants, ERC panel members, and stakeholders in European research funding
extracted.subtask_description: A news feed listing announcements and updates from the European Research Council relevant to ERC grant competitions, application rules, evaluation guidance, and institutional actions. Intended to inform researchers and stakeholders about policy changes and highlights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-submission / reapplication rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Readjusts rules for reapplication; changes intended to manage the surge in demand for ERC grants and pertaining to calls (mentions re-submission rules and concerns from the research community).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: News notes the ERC Scientific Council has listened to concerns and readjusted reapplication rules, but the page contains only an announcement summary rather than detailed rule text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility rules for 2027 ERC calls
rubrics_metrics.description: Calls for proposals in the 2027 competitions will introduce several changes to the eligibility rules for applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an announcement summarising that eligibility rules will change; the page does not include the specific eligibility criteria themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limits on AI use in grant evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: The ERC Scientific Council has adopted new guidelines on the use of artificial intelligence in the evaluation of grant proposals, aiming to safeguard the integrity of peer review while allowing limited use of AI where it does not [compromise integrity].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The news item reports the existence and intent of the guidelines but does not provide the detailed restrictions or permitted AI uses on this listing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stricter application measures amid rising demand
rubrics_metrics.description: ERC President explains stricter application measures introduced in response to rising demand for funding (text of an open letter to panel members, grantees and stakeholders).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This entry references policy tightening communicated by the ERC president; the listing provides only a summary and points readers to the full statement for specifics.
